title: How does work continue after a clean `asmai stop`?
body:
The sources are silent on this. AssemblyAI#7 says only that an unclean stop recovers through reconciliation at the next start, and that pending decisions, grants and queued requests survive a stop. AssemblyAI#14 says resumptions after `asmai stop` do not count toward the 5-dispatch limit, which assumes work resumes after a stop. Nothing says how a worker whose session ended with the daemon continues.

Rule 11 in the draft holds option A, marked as proposed.
rec: A. It is the reading AssemblyAI#14's counting rule assumes, and it keeps the clean and unclean stops of AssemblyAI#7 apart. With B, every planned restart, including every upgrade (stop, install, start), would cost a reconciliation of every running assignment.
options: A: the next start runs each worker that stopped at a boundary again on the same provider, resuming its native session where possible, with a new dispatch that is a resumption; if its session cannot be resumed, its assignment needs reconciliation
B: after any stop, every assignment that was in progress needs reconciliation by its owning leader, as after a crash

title: Accept 02 Daemon and store?
body: Accepting applies your answer above and any annotations. I then commit the document and start 03 Provider sessions and terminals. If you would rather see the changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my answers and annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
